name: Symbol of Ecstasy
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 8, sorcerer/wizard 8, witch 8
Components V, S, M (mercury and phosphorus, plus powdered diamond and opal worth a total of 5,000 gp)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like symbol of death, except all creatures within 60 feet of a symbol of ecstasy instead are overwhelmed with joy and pleasure. They are stunned for 1 round then staggered for 1 round per level. On a successful save, the target is staggered for 1 round.
